about: Session landing-pad names, one case list for both halves of the promise that an uploaded file's @mention resolves. The daemon renames (crates/chimaera-server/src/upload.rs mention_safe_name; tests/upload.rs include_str!s this file and asserts `raw` → `safe`). The UI half (net/uploadNames.test.ts) types each `safe` name the way insertUploadedPath does, `@<uploads dir>/<safe> `, and asserts the UI's own path parser (shared/fileRef.ts extractFileRefs) and claude's @-mention extractor (a pinned copy) both read the whole path. A case added here runs on both sides.
raw — the name the browser sends (File.name: a basename, already free of separators and control bytes). safe — the name the file lands under.

a 12-hour screenshot: a narrow no-break space before PM
a Finder duplicate's parentheses

claude's line anchor and MCP-resource colon
